description:
Welcome to Earth Mirror! 🌍🚀

We are passionate about space, Earth observation, technology, and innovation. Our goal is to explore creative ideas, solve real-world challenges, and learn together.

We're looking for motivated team members with skills in Python, AI, data analysis, web development, and UI/UX design.

If you enjoy exploring new ideas, solving problems, and working as a team, we'd love to have you join us!
